product_one_liner.value: Orange Logic provides enterprises with digital and media asset management software to centralize content, govern assets and rights, and automate content workflows with AI.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link was found in the navigation or footer, and /pricing did not return a public pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: The official blog is product/marketing-focused. The architecture articles checked are by its Head of Content; two qualifying engineer-authored build posts were not established.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes REST API guidance, DataTable APIs and external-API automation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Applied AI Product Engineer is listed among current openings.

model_provider.value: NVIDIA Nemotron; AWS Titan via Amazon Bedrock
model_provider.notes: Orange Logic announced embedding Nemotron in Agent Studio; its AWS integration page names Titan models through Bedrock for AI search.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 is Type 2. The page groups certifications, regulations and standards together; these are public compliance claims.

last_funding.notes: Strategic growth investment from Bregal Sagemount announced May 16, 2023; the amount was undisclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round was in May 2023, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers list contains no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced Orange Builder on September 30, 2026, to generate responsive brand pages using brand guidelines and governed DAM assets.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Shawnna Sumaoang's profile lists an August 2026 start as Vice President of Marketing.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly listed product integrations, not confirmation of Orange Logic's internal CRM adoption.
